meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 做出有辨识度、不落俗套的界面设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想做出有辨识度、不显模板化的界面。
copy.tagline_en: Create distinctive, intentional UI with confident visual choices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a distinctive look beyond default templates.

howto.what: 做前端界面设计时,它会先定一个具体主题和受众,给出配色、字体、布局和唯一「签名元素」的设计计划;自评不像套模板后再写代码。
howto.when: 当你要求做新 UI 或改造现有界面时接管;需求没写清产品或主题时,它会先替你定一个再开始设计。

say.text: 帮我做个作品集首页,先给设计方案,别直接写代码
say.note: 它会先输出配色、字体、布局计划

say.text: 这个落地页太像模板了,视觉方向重做一版
say.note: 它会指出默认套路并改掉

say.text: 给这个页面定一套字体和配色,并说明每项理由
say.note: 每项选择都从设计计划推导

howto.what_en: For frontend UI work it first names a concrete subject and audience, then produces a design plan — palette, typefaces, layout, one signature element — critiques it for templated defaults, and only then writes the code.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask for a new UI or a redesign of an existing one. If the brief leaves the subject or direction open, it picks one and states it.

say_en.text: Design a portfolio homepage — give me the plan before code
say_en.note: It shares palette, type and layout first

say_en.text: This landing page feels templated — redo the visual direction
say_en.note: It names the default look and revises

say_en.text: Pick a typeface and palette for this page, with reasons
say_en.note: Each choice comes from the design plan
